description: Speech to text with Whisper large-v3 turbo: pass the URL of an audio file (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A; up to 15 MB) and get the transcript, detected language, duration, word count and timed segments. Optional language hint. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

language.description: Two-letter language hint (en, fr); detected when omitted

url.description: Public URL of the audio file
